Method of Attack: Denial of service attack causing Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) by accessing a special Win32 device namespace path without proper error checking
Deploying ransomware to delay investigations during an attack
Attack Vector: Opening a special path (\\.\globalroot\device\condrv\kernelconnect) in Windows 10
Using a Windows URL file (.url) pointing to the problematic path
Remote execution of commands accessing the path on Windows 10 devices
Indicators of Compromise: Windows URL file (.url) with setting pointing to the above path
BSOD crashes triggered by accessing the path
